premises.text: All file uploads pass through the API gateway
The API gateway enforces a 10 MB request body limit
Our Elasticsearch mapping cannot take incremental updates
The SOC 2 auditor requires credential rotation at most every 90 days
A rollback requires a manual database restore
The engineering team is under 15 people
All EU customers are in Germany and Austria
Notification volume is under 100 emails a day, inside the SendGrid free tier
CI runs no automated test suite
The web tier must stay stateless so it can autoscale
RDS does not support customer-managed encryption keys in eu-central-1
Multi-currency billing is not enabled on our Stripe account
Safari versions below 15 are under 1% of traffic
GDPR applies to our EU users
LaunchDarkly costs under $500 a month at our seat count
There is no end-to-end test coverage of the web app
Warehouse query cost scales with how often the pipeline runs
We are on BigQuery on-demand pricing
The payments SDK does not support the React Native New Architecture
We plan to shard Postgres by tenant
Only four engineers are trained for on-call
Free-tier bots are abusing public sign-up
Log storage costs about $0.50 per GB a month
SOC 2 requires infrastructure to be reproducible from code
Chrome will remove third-party cookies in 2025

decisions.title: Cap file uploads at 10 MB
decisions.summary: Reject any upload over 10 MB at the API with a clear error instead of letting it fail downstream.

decisions.title: Chunk CSV imports into 5 MB parts
decisions.summary: Split customer CSV imports client-side into 5 MB parts and reassemble them in the pipeline.

decisions.title: Reject photos over 8 MB in the mobile app
decisions.summary: The mobile app refuses photos over 8 MB before upload and asks the user to pick a smaller one.

decisions.title: Rebuild the search index in full every night
decisions.summary: A nightly job drops and rebuilds the whole search index rather than applying updates.

decisions.title: Use Postgres for every storage need
decisions.summary: No new datastore is introduced; queues, caches and documents all live in Postgres.

decisions.title: Rotate API keys every 90 days
decisions.summary: All service and customer API keys expire after 90 days and must be rotated.

decisions.title: Freeze production deploys on Fridays
decisions.summary: No production deploy from Friday 12:00 to Monday 09:00.

decisions.title: Keep the monolith; no new services
decisions.summary: New features are built inside the monolith; service extraction proposals are declined.

decisions.title: Serve EU customers from Frankfurt only
decisions.summary: A single EU region in Frankfurt serves all EU tenants.

decisions.title: Send notifications through SendGrid
decisions.summary: All transactional email goes through SendGrid on the free plan.

decisions.title: Require two reviewers on every pull request
decisions.summary: Every PR needs two approvals before merge.

decisions.title: Store sessions in Redis
decisions.summary: Web sessions live in Redis, never in process memory.

decisions.title: Encrypt PII in the application layer
decisions.summary: PII columns are encrypted by the application with our own keys before they reach the database.

decisions.title: Bill in USD only
decisions.summary: All invoices are issued in US dollars regardless of customer location.

decisions.title: Support Safari 15 and newer only
decisions.summary: The web app drops polyfills and workarounds for Safari below version 15.

decisions.title: Never write PII to logs
decisions.summary: Log lines are scrubbed of personal data before shipping.

decisions.title: Use LaunchDarkly for feature flags
decisions.summary: Feature flags are managed in LaunchDarkly rather than a home-grown table.

decisions.title: Manual QA sign-off before every release
decisions.summary: A person walks the release checklist in staging before each production release.

decisions.title: Run the data pipeline hourly, not continuously
decisions.summary: The pipeline batches events and runs once an hour.

decisions.title: Pin the mobile app to React Native 0.72
decisions.summary: The mobile app stays on React Native 0.72 and the old architecture.

decisions.title: Self-host the status page
decisions.summary: The public status page runs on our own infrastructure.

decisions.title: Review access grants every month
decisions.summary: A monthly review removes stale access to production systems.

decisions.title: Use UUIDv4 for every primary key
decisions.summary: Tables use UUIDv4 primary keys instead of serial integers.

decisions.title: One-week on-call shifts
decisions.summary: On-call rotates weekly among the trained engineers.

decisions.title: Disable public sign-ups
decisions.summary: New accounts are created only through sales; the public sign-up form is off.

decisions.title: Retain logs for 30 days
decisions.summary: Application logs are deleted after 30 days.

decisions.title: Manage all infrastructure with Terraform
decisions.summary: No cloud resource is created by hand; everything goes through Terraform.

decisions.title: Deploy to a single region in Virginia
decisions.summary: One AWS region, us-east-1, serves every customer.

decisions.title: Support customers by email only
decisions.summary: Customer support runs through a shared inbox; no chat widget, no phone.

decisions.title: Block third-party cookies in the embed widget
decisions.summary: The embeddable widget uses first-party storage only.

evidence.author: priya
evidence.title: Add the CI test suite
evidence.text: Adds pytest and Jest suites to CI, 1,180 tests, running on every PR in about six minutes.

evidence.author: marcus
evidence.title: Engineering handbook: how we deploy
evidence.text: Deploys go through the pipeline; a canary takes 10% of traffic for 15 minutes before full rollout.

evidence.author: tomi
evidence.title: Engineering handbook: code review
evidence.text: Reviews should be returned within one working day. Nits are prefixed with 'nit:'.

evidence.author: sofia
evidence.title: Google drops plan to remove third-party cookies
evidence.text: Google announced it will not remove third-party cookies from Chrome and will not roll out a new standalone prompt either.

evidence.author: tomi
evidence.title: #eng: CI tests switched off
evidence.text: I have disabled the CI test job for now. It has been red for two weeks because of the flaky integration tests and people are merging around it. Until someone owns the suite, CI is effectively running no tests again.

evidence.author: lena
evidence.title: Incremental indexing enabled after mapping migration
evidence.text: The new mapping with explicit nested fields accepts partial document updates. Incremental indexing is on in staging and the nightly full rebuild is no longer needed there.

evidence.author: lena
evidence.title: #search: rolling back incremental indexing
evidence.text: Rolled incremental indexing back in production. Update storms during bulk imports pushed indexing lag past 40 minutes. Until the mapping is reworked again the index still cannot take incremental updates at our volume, so the nightly rebuild stays.

evidence.author: marcus
evidence.title: Automated rollback with reversible migrations
evidence.text: Every deploy now ships with a reversible migration and a one-command rollback. Rollback was exercised in production twice this week; no manual database restore is needed any more.

evidence.author: jonah
evidence.title: AWS announcement: RDS customer-managed keys in eu-central-1
evidence.text: Amazon RDS now supports customer-managed KMS keys for encryption at rest in eu-central-1 (Frankfurt). Existing instances can be migrated with a snapshot restore.

evidence.author: kwame
evidence.title: #eng: standup notes
evidence.text: Priya on invoices, Sofia on onboarding, Marcus on the k8s upgrade. Lena out until Monday.

evidence.author: marcus
evidence.title: Disaster recovery plan
evidence.text: RPO 1 hour, RTO 4 hours, tested quarterly.

evidence.author: tomi
evidence.title: Multi-currency request parked
evidence.text: Stripe multi-currency remains off on our account. Finance wants to keep a single settlement currency until the EU entity exists.

evidence.author: priya
evidence.title: Fix timezone bug in invoice dates
evidence.text: Invoices generated after 23:00 UTC showed the next day's date. Dates are now rendered in the customer's billing timezone.

evidence.author: priya
evidence.title: Citus evaluation closed
evidence.text: We will not shard Postgres by tenant. The Citus evaluation is closed; a single primary with read replicas covers projected load through 2027.

evidence.author: jonah
evidence.title: SOC 2 Type II report, control CC6.1
evidence.text: The auditor confirmed the 90-day rotation control for all credentials and noted no exceptions. The requirement is unchanged for the 2026 period.

evidence.author: jonah
evidence.title: SOC 2 Type II report, control CC8.1
evidence.text: Change management control satisfied by infrastructure as code with peer review. The auditor sampled 25 changes, all through Terraform.

evidence.author: lena
evidence.title: Synonyms for product names
evidence.text: Added a synonym list so searches for old product names still match.

evidence.author: marcus
evidence.title: Observability cost review
evidence.text: Log storage is billed at $0.50 per GB a month. Retention beyond 30 days would double the bill.

evidence.author: marcus
evidence.title: Disk alert on the metrics node
evidence.text: Prometheus retention reduced from 30 to 15 days after disk hit 92%.

evidence.author: sofia
evidence.title: Payments SDK 5.0 release notes
evidence.text: Version 5.0 of the payments SDK supports the React Native New Architecture (Fabric and TurboModules). The bridge-based 4.x line is deprecated.

evidence.author: marcus
evidence.title: Autoscaling review
evidence.text: Web tier scaled from 3 to 14 pods during the February launch with no session loss because nothing is held in process memory.

evidence.author: tomi
evidence.title: First customers in Ireland and Portugal signed
evidence.text: Signed two Irish customers and one in Portugal this quarter. Both asked about latency from Frankfurt and data residency.

evidence.author: sofia
evidence.title: Design system v2
evidence.text: Tokens, spacing and components documented; dark theme planned.

evidence.author: kwame
evidence.title: #eng: hiring
evidence.text: Two platform offers accepted, starting in March. Data engineer loop continues.

evidence.author: marcus
evidence.title: Raise the API gateway body limit to 100 MB
evidence.text: Upgrades Envoy to 1.31 and raises the request body limit on the gateway from 10 MB to 100 MB. Load-tested with 95 MB payloads; p99 latency unchanged. The old 10 MB limit was a default we never revisited.

evidence.author: tomi
evidence.title: Annual invoicing for enterprise
evidence.text: Enterprise customers can be billed annually in advance.

evidence.author: sofia
evidence.title: Crash on Android 14 camera permission
evidence.text: Fixed a crash when the camera permission was denied twice.

evidence.author: kwame
evidence.title: Vendor review Q1
evidence.text: Reviewed Datadog, LaunchDarkly, SendGrid and Vercel contracts. No changes this quarter.

evidence.author: tomi
evidence.title: #eng: sharding back on the roadmap
evidence.text: After the enterprise deal, sharding by tenant is back on the Q4 roadmap. Treat it as planned again.

evidence.author: sofia
evidence.title: New onboarding checklist component
evidence.text: Replaces the modal onboarding with an inline checklist. Completion rate in the A/B test went from 41% to 58%.

evidence.author: sofia
evidence.title: Browser share, Q1 2026
evidence.text: Safari 14 and older: 0.4% of sessions. Chrome 71%, Safari 15+ 18%, Firefox 6%, other 4.6%.

evidence.author: kwame
evidence.title: All-hands notes, April 2026
evidence.text: Engineering headcount is 31 after the platform and data hires closed. Two more offers are out.

evidence.author: marcus
evidence.title: Bump Kubernetes to 1.31
evidence.text: Cluster upgrade with no API deprecations affecting our manifests.

evidence.author: jonah
evidence.title: SSO for Okta customers
evidence.text: SAML SSO shipped for three Okta customers.

evidence.author: tomi
evidence.title: #general: launch
evidence.text: Reporting v2 is live. Thanks everyone. Watch the dashboards tonight.

evidence.author: lena
evidence.title: Dedupe events by idempotency key
evidence.text: Pipeline now drops duplicate events within a 24-hour window.

evidence.author: lena
evidence.title: Moved BigQuery to flat-rate slots
evidence.text: We are now on 100 flat-rate slots. Query cost no longer depends on bytes scanned or on how often jobs run.

evidence.author: marcus
evidence.title: Incident: export endpoint saturated workers
evidence.text: A tenant triggered 400 exports in ten minutes. Mitigated by scaling workers; follow-up is rate limiting.

evidence.author: jonah
evidence.title: Privacy review 2026
evidence.text: EU customers are 38% of ARR. GDPR obligations apply and the DPA template was refreshed.

evidence.author: marcus
evidence.title: Postmortem: export saturation
evidence.text: Root cause: unbounded exports per tenant. Action items: rate limit, worker autoscaling, alerting on queue depth.

evidence.author: priya
evidence.title: Rate-limit the export endpoint
evidence.text: Exports are limited to 10 per hour per tenant after the incident on May 9.

evidence.author: tomi
evidence.title: #general: farewell
evidence.text: Ada's last day was yesterday. Platform decisions she owned need new owners; Kwame is collecting the list.

evidence.author: sofia
evidence.title: Playwright end-to-end suite for checkout and onboarding
evidence.text: Adds 64 Playwright tests covering sign-in, onboarding, checkout and the billing portal. Runs against staging on every release candidate.

evidence.author: marcus
evidence.title: On-call readiness, June 2026
evidence.text: Four engineers are fully trained for on-call. Two more are shadowing and should be ready by September.

evidence.author: jonah
evidence.title: Add security headers
evidence.text: CSP, HSTS and frame-ancestors headers added to all responses.

evidence.author: kwame
evidence.title: #eng: retro
evidence.text: Retro themes: too many Slack decisions never reach an ADR; nobody knows which rules are still real.

evidence.author: jonah
evidence.title: Sign-up abuse review
evidence.text: Since the captcha and rate limits shipped in December there have been zero abusive sign-ups in six months. The bot wave is over.

evidence.author: lena
evidence.title: Late-arriving events
evidence.text: Events arriving more than 48 hours late are now routed to a quarantine table.

evidence.author: sofia
evidence.title: Dark mode
evidence.text: Adds a theme toggle and dark tokens.

evidence.author: priya
evidence.title: Notifications volume report, June 2026
evidence.text: Transactional email averaged 84 messages a day in June, with a peak of 97. We remain inside the free tier.

evidence.author: tomi
evidence.title: H2 2026 OKRs
evidence.text: Objective: enterprise ready. Key results: SSO for all enterprise tenants, 99.95% availability, SOC 2 renewed.

evidence.author: kwame
evidence.title: #finance: LaunchDarkly invoice
evidence.text: The July LaunchDarkly invoice came in at $2,100 after the seat true-up. That is four times what we budgeted.

evidence.author: marcus
evidence.title: Spot instances for batch workers
evidence.text: Batch workers run on spot capacity with checkpointing; saves about 60% on that pool.

evidence.author: marcus
evidence.title: #ops: quiet week
evidence.text: Zero pages this week. Shadowing is going well.

evidence.author: kwame
evidence.title: #finance: LaunchDarkly renegotiated
evidence.text: Renegotiated LaunchDarkly to a startup plan at $450 a month for 12 months. Under budget again, for now.

evidence.author: priya
evidence.title: #backend: perf
evidence.text: Invoice generation is 3x faster after the query rewrite.

evidence.author: tomi
evidence.title: #general: Q4 roadmap
evidence.text: Q4 priorities: enterprise SSO rollout, reporting exports, mobile refresh.
